title: Two-Pole 800-Step Horizon (Schedule=800 Diagnostic)
intuition: Extends `two_pole` 10x to 800 updates with a matching 800-step schedule horizon to diagnose whether scheduled baselines hold pole separation and bounded critic slopes over longer budgets.
failure_mode: Scheduled baselines can over-shoot or drift over 800 steps when tuned only for the 80-step horizon.
